content: {"reasoning":"PR-204 is an adjudicated noncoverage denial, so another clean submission would not address the payer’s determination; authorization rework is also inapplicable because this CPT requires no authorization and retro-authorization is unavailable. A formal appeal is permitted with the denial on file, and similar claims were paid more often after appeal (3/5) than after clean resubmission (3/6), while patient billing produced no payments.","action":"appeal_with_necessity"}
